subject: planner: move PhysicalJoin related logic into physical op dir (#63390)
summary: Reviewed this commit relative to its first parent. Changes are predominantly a refactor/re-homing: `JoinType` and `PhysicalJoin` are moved to a shared planner base layer, and planner/executor join-related code paths are updated to use the new types (`logicalop.*` → `base.*`), along with removal of duplicated/legacy definitions. Join plan enumeration/costing/hint generation and executor joiner/probe logic appear unchanged beyond type plumbing. No Blocker/High correctness, SQL semantics, session/txn, privilege/visibility, or concurrency issues found attributable to this commit.
